summary: TrackMyRMC Phase 2 (order lifecycle) fully verified. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_order_lifecycle.py covering customer create (PENDING w/ unique RMC-100x), KYC gating (unverified -> 403 KYC_REQUIRED; save_draft=true -> DRAFT ok), grade validation 422, detail w/ history (first entry to=PENDING), cancel PENDING->CANCELLED ok / DELIVERED->cancel 409, owner /home shape (plant_count=3, pending_approvals reflects new order, pending_orders list), owner /orders + ?status=PENDING scoping, owner approve PENDING->ACCEPTED with 'Approved by plant' history and customer notification, owner reject with reason -> REJECTED with reason in history, state-machine guard (approve of REJECTED -> 409), RBAC (customer token on /owner/* -> 403), foreign-order guard (random ObjectId -> 404). Same-state approve is idempotent 200 as per spec. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): customer login (+919000000001) auto-fills dev OTP and lands on Home showing an existing ACCEPTED order + KYC verified banner. 'New Order' quick action -> New Order screen renders 3 plants, grade chips (5 for Kondapur), quantity stepper, date chips (Today..Fri), time chips (06:00..16:00), site fields; Place Order navigates to /order/<id> showing status PENDING and timeline entry 'Order created / PENDING'. Plants tab 'Order Now' correctly routes to /new-order?plantId=<id> (pre-select param). Owner login (owner@trackmyrmc.test) routes to owner dashboard with 'Pending Approvals' card visible. Opening the PENDING order shows Approve + Reject buttons; Approve moves order to ACCEPTED (verified in UI). Reject flow opens a reason form with cancel/confirm buttons (testIDs reject-reason/reject-cancel/reject-confirm). Owner Orders tab filter chips: all/pending/accepted/production/dispatched/delivered/cancelled (horizontal scroll, no wrap) — all clickable. E2E: customer creates order, owner approves, customer detail page updates to ACCEPTED with 'Approved by plant' note in timeline.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use 'boxShadow') and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use 'style.pointerEvents'). Non-blocking, but should be migrated for React Native 0.75+. Reference: multiple screens (login, new-order).

action_items: (Optional) Migrate deprecated RN Web style props (shadow*, pointerEvents) to their modern equivalents (boxShadow / style.pointerEvents) to silence warnings.

(Optional) Note the pytest.<attr> module-attribute pattern used to share state between test classes fails under xdist parallel workers. The current /app/backend/pytest.ini uses '-n auto --dist loadscope' via addopts; running Phase 2 required '-o addopts=' to serialize. Consider either changing addopts to 'loadfile' scheduling or refactor to session-scoped fixtures if you want to keep xdist enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'); migrate to lifespan handler (non-blocking, carried over from iteration 1).

order_service.transition_order writes an audit entry and notifications on same-state transitions? Actually it returns early on current==target BEFORE writing history/audit/notifications — good, idempotent as intended.
routers/owner._guard_owns / owner_home use await owner_plant_ids(user_id) which returns str ids; queries then use plant_id (string) — consistent. Owner-plant isolation verified.
customer.create_order uses next_sequence('order_number') for uniqueness. Verified RMC-1003+ post-seed, no collision with seeded RMC-1001/1002.
Frontend Input component correctly forwards testID to the underlying TextInput (contrary to iteration_1 note); no fix needed here.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase 2 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_order_lifecycle.py.
